definitions.explanation: A polite expression used when making a request or asking someone to do something.
Used when ordering at a restaurant or shop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手伝|てつだ}い→手伝い：02488_tetsudai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お{願|ねが}いします。
⟦よろしく→よろしく：01070_yoroshiku⟧お{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: Nice to meet you. / Thank you in advance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{静|しず}かに→静か：00755_shizuka⟧お{願|ねが}いします。⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Please be quiet. We're in class.

examples.japanese: ⟦{早|はや}く→早く：02935_hayaku⟧お{願|ねが}いします。⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ありません→ある：00006_aru⟧。⟦{急|いそ}いで→急ぐ：01191_isogu⟧⟦いただける→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{助|たす}かります→助かる：01956_tasukaru⟧。
examples.english: Please hurry. There's no time. It would help if you could hurry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お{願|ねが}いします。
⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お{願|ねが}いします。
⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お{願|ねが}いします。
⟦{定食|ていしょく}→定食：03123_teishoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧お{願|ねが}いします。
⟦すみません→すみません：00998_sumimasen⟧、⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お{願|ねが}いします。⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{買|か}いました→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: Excuse me, I'll take all of these please. I bought a lot today.

notes:
お{願|ねが}いします is one of the most essential polite expressions in Japanese, literally meaning 'I make a request' (from ⟦{願|ねが}う→願う：02387_negau⟧, to wish/request).

FORMALITY LEVELS:
- ⟦お{願|ねが}い→お願い：10299_onegai⟧: casual (among friends)
- お{願|ねが}いします: polite (standard)
- お{願|ねが}い⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧: humble/formal (business)
- お{願|ねが}い⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧: very formal (written)

COMMON SET PHRASES:
- ⟦よろしく→よろしく：01070_yoroshiku⟧お{願|ねが}いします: please treat me well (greetings, requests)
- ご⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お{願|ねが}いします: please confirm
- ご⟦{協力|きょうりょく}→協力：00261_kyouryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お{願|ねが}いします: please cooperate

USAGE:
When ordering, use [item]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お{願|ねが}いします. When requesting actions, the request is implied from context. Often used standalone as a polite closer to any request.

COMPARED WITH ⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧:
Both make requests, but ください attaches to a verb (⟦{待|ま}って→待つ：00469_matsu⟧ください, please wait) while お{願|ねが}いします attaches to a noun or stands alone. お{願|ねが}いします is also the softer and more deferential of the two, so it is the safer choice with strangers, customers, and superiors.
